info.name: Kanmon Public V2 Bank Accounts Businesses API

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma delimited list of Kanmon’s unique IDs for businesses.

params.name: platformBusinessIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of your platform’s unique IDs for businesses.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of records to skip when performing pagination. Defaults to `0`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of records to limit when performing pagination. Defaults to `100`, which is the max.

params.name: createdAtStart
params.description: Filter for records where `createdAt` is greater than or equal to this value. ISO 8601 format.

params.name: createdAtEnd
params.description: Filter for records where `createdAt` is less than or equal to this value. ISO 8601 format.

params.name: id
params.description: Either the Kanmon business UUID or your platform’s business ID, depending on `idType`.

params.name: idType
params.description: Which ID type to query the business by. Defaults to `KANMON`. Use `PLATFORM` if you want to query by your platform’s ID.
